name: com.veilbreak.gui
description: Portable UI Toolkit kit and source of the Veilbreak design system (Veil theme): generated tokens, fonts and icons, cut-corner shapes painted from USS, themed buttons and form controls, Power/focus/health meters, skill buttons, operative and perk cards, hover/tap popovers, a translucent portrait battle HUD, camera gestures, a portrait screen layer (navigator, safe area, dialogs), text/label/badge/tile/card atoms, forms, stack/list/grid/board layouts and the arcade's thirteen screen views. Ships a React web kit (Web~) and the GUI Handbook (docs/). Data-agnostic: bind plain view models from any game.

samples.description: Every component in its main states, bound to sample view models.
A portrait battle board with fake data: HUD band, manual queue, operative cards and the world layer.
